verdict.rationale: PayPal has several built-in background automations: recurring subscription billing with automated recovery of failed payments, automatic invoice payment reminders, and webhooks that push events to your server. The Disputes API and agent toolkit let developers build their own automated workflows, but those workflows must be hosted and orchestrated by the user's own systems. Missing for 10: a native user-configurable automation/scheduling builder, PayPal-hosted autonomous agent runs or triggers, and independent hands-on corroboration.
